content.text:
## Investigation findings

**Summary:** The user-facing symptoms (slow requests and HTTP 500s at the UI and load generator) trace to one primary fault: every order-preserve request fails on its call from `ts-preserve-service` to `ts-basic-service`. A secondary effect is elevated latency in the travel fan-out, which looks like load-driven slowdown rather than a separate fault.

### 1. Affected endpoints

| Service / endpoint | Abnormal vs normal | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/v1/preserveservice/preserve` (ts-preserve-service) | 284 HTTP 500s, 0 in normal. Avg 393 ms, max 7.7 s | Primary failing endpoint |
| `POST /api/v1/preserveservice/preserve` at ts-ui-dashboard | 14 HTTP 500s, avg 8.4 s, max 18.7 s | User-facing symptom |
| `POST .../travelservice/trips/left` (ts-travel-service) | Avg 547 ms vs 229 ms, p95 2.8 s vs 0.8 s | Secondary latency |
